# Tabler Icons

- Repository: https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons
- Version: 3.34.1 (published package)
- License: MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)
- Used for engine command icons whose command name maps directly onto a Tabler glyph.

The SVG path geometry is used unchanged. Only the canvas size and ink colour are
adapted when the engine icon theme is generated.
